metrics.summary:
Fixed `HelpFormatter.write_usage` in src/click/formatting.py: when `args` is empty it now writes exactly one line — the indented prefix plus the program name with the trailing space stripped — and returns before the wrap/branch logic. Previously, wrapping the empty string with `wrap_text` produced `""` (or an indent-only line in the narrow-width branch), yielding either a bare `"
"` or an extra line with stray spaces, plus the trailing space after the program name in the narrow-width branch. Verified with a repro script (default and custom prefix, widths 50/60/80/200, over-long program name, indented formatter — all produce exactly `Usage: Program
` / `Run: Program
` with no trailing space or extra lines) and confirmed non-empty-args output is byte-identical to before. Full test suite passes: 1602 passed, 1 skipped, 24 skipped (termui), 1 xfailed.
